title: Screening LLM Judges Without Ground Truth: A Preliminary Evaluation of an AI Dental Hygiene Coach
abstract: arXiv:2610.24335v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluating a fine-tuned coaching model with expert graders is slow and expensive, and an LLM judge cannot be trusted without ground truth. We present a staged pipeline that screens candidate LLM judges and student models before expert review, using explicit decision rules at each stage: judge output audit, similarity with hosted judges, bias checks, and decision robustness. We demonstrate it on an AI dental hygiene coach. The case study uses synthetic, clinically unvalidated training and reference data to demonstrate the operation of the pipeline, rather than to establish the clinical performance of the resulting models. Two fine-tuned small language models (Granite-4.1-8B and Qwen3-8B), each trained at three data sizes, were scored on seven metrics by five judges (three local, two hosted). Two local judges, Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-31B-it, were not distinguishable from the agreement between the hosted judges on six of seven metrics b

translated_title: 无需真实标签筛选大语言模型评审：AI口腔卫生辅导系统的初步评估
translated_abstract: 使用专家评分员评估微调后的辅导模型既缓慢又昂贵，而在缺乏真实标签的情况下，大语言模型评审器（LLM judge）的可信度难以保证。我们提出了一种分阶段流水线，在专家评审之前筛选候选的大语言模型评审器和学生模型，每个阶段均采用明确的决策规则：评审输出审计、与托管评审器的一致性比较、偏见检查以及决策稳健性分析。我们在一个AI口腔卫生辅导系统上对该流水线进行了演示。该案例研究使用合成的、未经临床验证的训练与参考数据来展示流水线的运行过程，而非用于确立所得模型的临床性能。两个微调的小型语言模型（Granite-4.1-8B和Qwen3-8B），各自在三种数据规模下训练，由五位评审器（三个本地、两个托管）按七项指标进行评分。两个本地评审器Qwen3.8-27B和Gemma-4-31B-it在七项指标中的六项上，其一致性水平与托管评审器之间的一致性无法区分。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需真实标签即可在专家评审前分阶段筛选大语言模型评审器的流水线，并通过AI口腔卫生辅导系统案例验证了本地评审器与托管评审器具有几乎一致的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a staged pipeline for screening LLM judges without ground truth prior to expert review, demonstrated on an AI dental hygiene coach where local judges showed agreement indistinguishable from that between hosted judges.
